description:
Vulnerability scanner developed by Tenable


Changed Functionality and Performance Enhancements

The following changes are included in Tenable Nessus 10.12.6:
- Linking a Tenable One Vulnerability Management-managed scanner using the --aws-scanner flag from an AWS-hosted scanner is no longer restricted to Amazon Linux.
Bug Fixes
| Bug Fix                                                                                                                                                                               | Defect ID                             |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| Fixed an issue where an offline Tenable Nessus Manager could create corrupt agent plugin sets after a backup restore when no plugins had been compiled yet.                           | 02542859                              |
| Fixed an issue causing scans to frequently use reverse DNS lookup results instead of provided hostnames, which was incorrect in certain cases.                                        | 638235, 505891, 228839, 99583, 238446 |
| Fixed an issue where setting up a scanner to be managed by Tenable Security Center (Legacy) in the registration wizard failed with an error.                                          | 02568757, 02574283, 02578437          |
| Fixed an issue where migrating to Tenable One Vulnerability Management failed to import scans due to a mismatch between Windows-style time zone names and IANA time zone identifiers. | 02527746                              |
Supported Platforms
The following are supported platform updates made in Tenable Nessus 10.12.6:
- Removed support for the following operating systems:
  - Windows Server 2012 and 2012 R2
  - Ubuntu 16.04
  - RHEL and derived distributions version 8 minor versions before 8.10
  - macOS 14
Upgrade Notes
- Tenable One Vulnerability Management FedRAMP environments support Tenable Nessus scanners versions 10.5.0 and later.
- If you are connecting to Tenable One Vulnerability Management through Tenable Nessus scanners, Tenable Agents, Tenable One Web App Scanning scanners, or Tenable Network Monitors (NNM) located in mainland China, you must connect through sensor.cloud.tenablecloud.cn instead of sensor.cloud.tenable.com.
- You can upgrade to the latest version of Tenable Nessus from any previously supported version.
- If your upgrade path skips versions of Tenable Nessus, Tenable recommends reviewing the release notes for all skipped versions to learn about new features and bug fixes.
- If you want your scanners to update to the newest version before the GA date automatically, set your Tenable Nessus Update Plan to Opt in to Early Access releases.
- If you want to update your scanners to the latest version before the GA date manually, disable automatic updates so the scanner does not automatically downgrade to the previous version.
